findings.summary: M20.28 lets the driver pick which commits' cold-setup readings count. Any three recorded M20 readings decide the median, and checkColdReadings (milestone-checks.mjs:1009) counts whatever is recorded after 'from'. The M20 CI cold-setup spans so far range from 315 to 514 s. Recording 9bcd74d, 583c1da and 0ae22eb gives a median of 333 s and passes. All seven give 451 s and fail. The 420 s commitment (M19 final F2 argued line) therefore looks unmet today, and the leg as specified can still go green on a hand-picked sample.
findings.suggestion: Amend M20.28 so the leg counts every completed main CI run's cold-setup reading from the row's first commit to HEAD, or the last N consecutive runs, never a chosen subset. check-budget or the leg can fetch them, so recording is not a selection step. With the readings so far, start the cut now (M19.61's docs step first), with COLD_SETUP_MAX_MS unchanged.

When the runner cleaned up it killed tsc, node and chrome-headless processes that were still running, and the stuck-build artifact was empty. progress.md mentions this only to explain a missing cold reading. There is no Fixes row, diagnosis or argued line. Later macOS verify steps took 9, 5 and 14 min, so the job sits close to its limit with high variance. check-ci-evidence treats the red as healed by later greens, so nothing will look at it again before it recurs.

findings.summary: ADR-0056 says 'FR-EXP-004 is not narrowed'. Under it, 'opens identically in Inkscape' is checked only for the outlined default. Embedded-font fixtures are only opened in Inkscape, not diffed, because Inkscape ignores @font-face data URLs. That is a defensible reading of 'fonts embedded or outlined option', but it is a narrowing of the embed option's acceptance, and per the backlog header a checkpoint must ratify it.
